name: What preventative measures can I take to extend my deck's lifespan after repair?

mainEntity.name: What preventative measures can I take to extend my deck's lifespan after repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: After deck repair, regular maintenance is key to extending its lifespan. This includes annual cleaning to remove dirt and mildew, reapplying stains or sealants every few years to protect against moisture and UV damage, and promptly addressing any minor issues like loose fasteners. Keeping the area around your deck clear of debris and ensuring proper drainage also helps prevent future damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Regular cleaning, reapplying stains or sealants, and promptly addressing minor issues will extend your deck's lifespan after repair.
